12. SECURITY DEPOSIT. The Licensee shall pay to the Licensor an interest-free refundable security deposit of Rs. 1,50,000/- (Rupees One Lakh Fifty Thousand only) on or before the date of possession. The deposit shall be refunded within thirty (30) days of the Licensee vacating the Premises, after deducting any amounts towards unpaid licence fee, damages and painting charges.
13. LOCK-IN. Neither party shall terminate this Agreement during the first six (6) months from the Commencement Date, save as provided in Clause 17.
